input.summary: Add professional liability (E&O) of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy liability of $2,000,000 to M&I's § 14.1(A) insurance schedule.
input.comment: [Playbook] M&I's insurance schedule carries no professional liability or cyber cover, which is our minimum position for a provider that processes our customer data. We have added E&O of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of $2,000,000 to the existing § 14.1(A) list, so the existing carrier-rating and certificate mechanics in § 14.1(B) apply unchanged.

ops.text: Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance in an amount not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000), and Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance in an amount not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000).
